pr.title: B02 Board movement odds engine
pr.body:
Untyped board input such as `next: 'AB'` previously became two branches, and missing/null adjacency silently became a dead end. B02 now requires an adjacency array containing string IDs and rejects malformed input with `TypeError` through both public odds APIs.

This checkpoint adds 20 rejection checks and a named fixture confirming that the target policy uses directed edge-hop distance through pass-through nodes. Valid dead ends, cycles, self-loops, and unreachable targets retain their documented behavior.

The full local `npm test` passed with Node 24.19.0 and locked TypeScript 5.8.3, using seeds 1, 2, and 3:

- 2,000 random DAGs and 500 cyclic graphs per seed, both policies, every start, faces 0–10, exact mixtures, and literal finite-path comparisons.
- 150,000,000 complete seeded simulated rolls; every required four-sigma gate passed.
- 25 isolated mutants per seed compiled strictly and failed runtime assertions: 75/75 kills.
- 25 named graphs, 350 differential fixture cases, 36 malformed-input checks, and 1,000 rational pairs per seed.
- Strict compilation and checksum verification completed for every seed.

The integrated blind reference is unchanged and matches its pre-exchange seal (`fb3358b51f3c8d6f00ca649da54d283129613cd0229ac33e626519f7daf22e5f`). A separate review confirmed the new rejection checks and policy outputs; additional valid-input review found no further odds defect. Exact commands, source hashes, per-seed counters, simulation bins, and mutation evidence are in `VERIFY.md` and `evidence/cloud-*`.

**[Observed successful final-head CI](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-gpt-drops/actions/runs/37644498365)** completed successfully at `4ee574ba80aba226e43ea4cea7bd7ceb0f69513e`, with fresh locked installation and the same full suite. Official run metadata confirmed `completed/success` for that exact SHA. The KEEP GOING pass strengthened the weakest malformed-input boundary and reran every required check; the subsequent review found no additional substantive defect.

pr.body:
The current milestone investigates original Western Land screenshots and preserves an unresolved source discrepancy. Nine of 34 article image elements were fetched in two genuine passes and all 18 full images were personally opened. The native Milk Saloon menu offers one invitee for 10 coins and everyone for 20, while the author prose says two for 20. That discrepancy is retained; the whole Milk fact remains unadopted pending complete scope review. Train ticket screenshots omit ordinary 3/6-coin fares and the complete Event movement rule, so the unknown Steamer Event remains unknown.

**Current delivery:** `cfce47dc560fef9a9d9458adf33d3d2d0d2a87e3`, actually published **2026-10-09 09:36:13 UTC**, single parent `5dd680140d003862b1fc774a265bc0e6bdd23a0f`; actual source interval **24m49s**, within 30 minutes. **Pipeline / Draft / NOT_MET.** Current coverage remains **90/518**: 90 corroborated, 409 single-source, 18 unresolved disagreements, one unverified current Steamer Event; known current events **37/38**. All 518 complete fact objects/values, source registries, original conflicts, verifier, schema, workflow, quote ceilings and rejection fixtures are byte-identical to the preceding Gold source. No new authored quotations or Namu/Cel words.

**Genuine exact current original CI:** [run 37912340823](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-gpt-drops/actions/runs/37912340823), sole verify [113760220435](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-gpt-drops/actions/runs/37912340823/job/113760220435), naturally completed **09:36:28 UTC**, all nine original steps successful. - Original structural/checksum command: **actual exit 0, 26 suites / 5,673 cases, all 89 manifest entries pass**. Local final commands and independent full `sha256sum -c` agree.

Nintendo’s full Mario Party overview and Scarlet Dunning’s separately authored firsthand Mac Weekly introductory paragraph support the exact existing wording. **ROUND01 alone** changes evidence/status; its **medium confidence** remains unchanged. The review’s later erroneous Lucky Bonus example is excluded.

This remains a **blocked research draft, strict original acceptance NOT MET**: **38/95 corroborated, 34 single-source, three conflicts and 20 explicit unknowns**. No guessed rule, video timestamp, frame, speaker or installed-patch behavior was added.

The bounded recovery used **six search angles, 48 returned results, 38 exact unique URLs and eight complete candidate contexts**. Only the literal four-player/round paragraph qualified. Pass A was observed 07:00:02–07:00:04 UTC; B 07:00:28–07:00:30 UTC. Every original validation and strict gate still executes. Actual current checks: **21 structural suites / 2,094 cases**, **20 strict suites / 1,926 cases / documented exit 1**, **168 manifest entries**, original **538 scope assertions / 12 actual malformed controls**, plus **122 new scope assertions / 14 actual malformed controls** and the original ten schema/review rejection cases. pr.body:
B06’s original four pure CPU policy functions remain verified. **The PR stays draft: research is blocked on 24 controlled Nintendo behavior gaps** across Easy, Normal, Hard and Master branch, item, shop, star, Buddy and minigame behavior. No research fact was promoted in this recovery.

Current head: `35614005b528fde715229f5b162c66675ec8cf4f`.
[BLOCKED.md](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-gpt-drops/blob/35614005b528fde715229f5b162c66675ec8cf4f/jobs/B06-cpu-policy/BLOCKED.md) records the missing source, bounded investigation and exact conditions for resuming. Main now records `B06 BLOCKED`; the product and evidence remain on the existing job branch, unmerged.

## Actual current full verification

[Run 37894274609](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-gpt-drops/actions/runs/37894274609), job 113701920468: **SUCCESS at 2026-10-09 06:36:51 UTC**, accepted from the complete native log at 06:38:52 UTC. The log binds its tested PR merge to exact head `3561400`. Clean npm ci and the unchanged complete npm test passed all original seeds 1, 2 and 3:

- 240 explained scenarios: 20 per decision function per seed.
- 1,200,000 random legal states with independent result, RNG and purity comparisons.
- 30,000 toy games and 2,880,000 complete policy decision comparisons. Hard wins remain 9971/9934/9952 out of 10,000 per seed; these are toy-model results.
- 75 separately strict-compiled, actually executed source mutants killed.
- Three schema/source-audit results: 33 rows, 11 sources, 44 recorded quote recoveries; strict research correctly remains NOT_MET.

Full current native log: 22,094 UTF-8 bytes, SHA256 `5bc1c4d084c8ee0430570be85b29ea60990d0f7479df8f2cbbc8617f5abe0c44`.
The original workflow uploads no artifact. Its complete native log and the unchanged committed detailed records provide the genuine evidence.

The fresh independent reader passed all six complete historical seed archives, mutation source hashes and assertion witnesses, all nine source seals and all 58 manifest checks. All 59 current B06/workflow Git inputs remained unchanged during acceptance. `node tests/research-strict.mjs` genuinely exits **1** on the same 24 gaps; this failure is retained and not waived.

## Evidence recovery and limits

Six distinct Exa search angles returned 48 candidates / 43 exact unique URLs. Eight promising authored contexts were fetched and read in full. The reviewed numerical AI reference concerns Mario Party 1, the reviewed Jamboree editor/tutorial concern map editing, and the other reviewed contexts provide anecdotes, walkthroughs or general mechanics. None supplies the required controlled four-difficulty behavior records.

The [bounded search receipt](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-gpt-drops/blob/35614005b528fde715229f5b162c66675ec8cf4f/jobs/B06-cpu-policy/reports/20261009-recovery/bounded-evidence-search.json) preserves every candidate, eight scoped assessments and capture hashes. Full tool responses and authored bodies remain in ignored private work. This is a bounded negative result, not an exhaustive absence proof. Extraction may be cached; origin HTTP status and personally watched video frames are unobserved. Search snippets are not factual evidence.

Only 13 B06 documentation/evidence files changed. The sealed policy, types, contract, independent implementation, original research rows, conflicts, both source audits, toy board, original harness, counts, thresholds and workflow are unchanged. The original two-source F08 labels and low-confidence F09 Buddy reports remain historical evidence; all 24 controlled behavior gaps remain.

The earlier `4f030d4` and inherited `baf87d4` green runs are preserved as historical receipts. Current blocked-delivery acceptance is complete; the dated NEXT/VERIFY instruction to inspect the new run has now been fulfilled by the actual current-head result above. Research resumes only when controlled original-version logs or primary technical evidence are available, with the original two-independent-source and full-reopen requirements. Complete research acceptance and KEEP GOING remain blocked. No PartyBox port, hardware experiment or Nintendo probabilities are claimed.

- All full seeds 1/2/3: 150,000 random midgame comparisons, 606,528 ordered scoring cases and 75 separately strict-compiled/runtime-killed mutants.

- Strict TypeScript, pure production API, zero runtime dependencies; every delivered file is at most 12.44 MB. Default npm test runs every full seed; the readonly Ubuntu workflow runs that exact command with a 30-minute timeout.
